rows.en: Yeah, I figured something was off. I've never seen Fuuto like this.
This is a Dopant's doing. And what's more...
There's only one guy who could pull off a stunt like this.
No way...! The Weather Dopant...!?
That's right. I'm going after him.
Is that a Nemo...? It's under attack!? Is this the "invisible enemy" Accel mentioned!?
We have to help!!
...Ugh.
Nemo!!
B-be careful... The enemy is... hiding... somewhere...
Got it! Don't try to talk anymore!
No, listen to me... I have... a favor to ask...
Zeta Gundam and Methuss... the enemy has...
Zeta Gundam and Methuss...!? Where are they!?
F-further ahead... Ngh...
Nemo!!
Hang in there!
Stay with us!!
...Damn it. ...So it's no use?
Not with wounds like these...
If we'd been just one step faster, we might have been able to save them...
Zeta and Methuss are up ahead...? But if we don't even know what the enemy is...
What are you hesitating for? We have to hurry!!
If your hand can reach them and you don't reach out... you'll regret it so much you'll want to die!
We're short on info either way. We can work out a plan once we're on the move.
...Understood. You're both right.
Wait! Someone's there...!
R-reporting in...
This is very hard to say, but...
What is it? Spit it out.
W-well... We let Zeta and Methuss get away...
What was that?
You useless bastard!! Get out of my sight!!
Go have yourself a nice long rest...
Forever!
"SLASH!!!"
Urgh...
Now then, I know you're there! Come on out! I'll smash you to pieces myself!!
...Don't tell me the invisible enemy was you!? Barabas, the Assassin Choju!!
Fuhahahahahaha!!! That's right!!
Why!? You never had a power like that!
Neat, huh? It's called optical camouflage. Tech from another world, apparently.
You're not even a Dopant, so why do you have a Memory!?
Optical camouflage...? How did you get your hands on that!?
You've got no need to know that.
Optical camouflage, activate!!
...Huh!? What's going on!? Why am I not vanishing!? Is this thing defective!?
Optical camouflage, activate!!
Damn it!! Every last one of them is useless when it counts!!
I never needed cheap tricks like this to crush you powerless lot in the first place!!
...Damn it... To think I'd lose... Gu... GWAAAAGH!!
...Heh heh heh.
Weather Dopant...!!
Th-that Memory you gave me... It doesn't even work...
The optical camouflage I gave you... It seems you couldn't put it to proper use.
So it's no substitute for this Memory after all.
The Invisible Memory!? If I remember right, that's a Gaia Memory that turns its user invisible...
However, to master this Memory, one must be compatible with it...
Like me!!
"INVISIBLE"
The Invisible Memory... It still needs some adjustment.
Found you, Weather Dopant! So it was you after all!!
I will never forgive you! ...Not after you took everything from me!!
Hm? Whatever do you mean?
Don't play dumb!!! I won't let you say you've forgotten!!
I'm a busy man, so I'll be taking my leave. I've no time to waste on the likes of you.
"KRAKA-KRAKA-KRAAASH!!"
You bastaaaaard!!!!
Hey! Accel! Wait up!!
...Tch, he took off.
Still, that enemy from before... It said they let Zeta and Methuss get away.
Hahahaha!!
Well, Zeta Gundam! Methuss! How do you like the taste of our "Spider Web"!?

notes.note: Extracted speaker labels in MainEventMess0110 are unreliable (several are shifted or wrong); speakers below were inferred from content. Labels in 0108 #0.14 (W) and 0110 #0.53-0.55 also look wrong.
Object omitted in source; restored as 'them' (the dying Nemo, glossary g=n).
Dying Nemo trails off mid-sentence; kept unfinished ('the enemy has...').
OOO (Eiji)'s signature 'reach out your hand' creed; 'regret it to death' rendered as 'regret it so much you'll want to die'.
No speaker recovered; a party member (likely Nu Gundam) spotting the scene. Written speaker-neutral.
Reporter is a Masquerade Dopant grunt reporting to the invisible Barabas (rows 0.3-0.7). Labels say otherwise.
Labelled W (Shotaro) but clearly Barabas berating and then killing the grunt (0.8-0.10). 0.12 'Urgh' is the grunt dying.
SFX in corner brackets rendered in double quotes; same for 0.42 (Gaia Memory voice) and 0.51 (lightning).
Speaker is an Ultra (likely Zero) despite '???' label. Barabas's epithet 'satsujinya chouju' rendered 'Assassin Choju' (Ultra fandom term for Ace-era monsters); alternative 'Assassin Super Beast'.
Labelled Zero, but it is Barabas boasting about the camouflage. 0.23 (labelled Barabas) is a hero, probably W; 0.24 (labelled Zero) a hero, possibly Nu Gundam. 0.31 (labelled Zero) is Barabas.

Uncertain: read as Weather musing that the optical camouflage failed as a stand-in for the Invisible Memory (his experiment). Alternative reading: offering the Memory as a replacement, but 'substitute for this Memory' grammar favours the former.
Labelled Barabas, but it's a hero (likely W) explaining the Invisible Memory; 0.40 (labelled Barabas) is Weather Dopant (polite speech, 'this Memory').
0.46-0.52 unlabelled; Accel (Ryu Terui, whose family Weather killed) vs Weather Dopant.
Labelled Accel but addressed to Accel; speaker is W (Shotaro). 0.54 likewise W. 0.55 (labelled Weather Dopant) is a hero, probably Nu Gundam; 'that enemy' = the Masquerade grunt (g=n, 'it').

report: 80/80 rows. Speaker labels in MainEventMess0110 largely misaligned; speakers inferred from content (see notes). Uncertain: 0110#0.38 (substitute reading), 0110#0.15 epithet 'Assassin Choju'. No names outside glossary except the epithet 'Choju' and terms 'optical camouflage', 'Invisible Memory', 'Spider Web' (Hambrabi tactic). No rows over 110 chars.
